name: Fish Hooks Ronpa
source:
Fish Hooks Ronpa is a crossover between DanganRonpa and Disney's Fish Hooks.

When Mackerel Naegi gets accepted into the prestigious Fish Hope's Peak Academy, he is soon trapped and forced to participate in a death game.

[From [url=https://vlt21.itch.io/fhr-beta1]itch.io[/url]]
